content.short: SubQuery is an open-source, universal blockchain data indexer that provides fast, flexible, decentralized APIs.
content.description: SubQuery is an open-source, universal blockchain data indexer for developers that delivers fast, flexible, reliable, and decentralized APIs to empower multi-chain applications. Each SubQuery project provides a complete API to organize and query data from layer-1 networks. It currently supports Ethereum, Polygon, BNB, NEAR, Polkadot, Avalanche, Algorand, Cosmos, Arbitrum, and Flare projects. This data-as-a-service platform lets developers concentrate on their core use cases and frontend without building a custom backend for data processing. In the future, SubQuery Network aims to offer an entirely decentralized, scalable solution.
